title: Spreading a geometrically connected fibre open in a flat geometrically reduced family
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and of finite presentation, meaning locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Suppose that for every $t\in S$ the fibre $Y_t=Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-residue-field] is geometrically reduced over $\kappa(t)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Let $s\in S$ and let $T\subseteq Y_s$ be an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion] geometrically connected over $\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]; connected includes nonempty [def-weil-connected-scheme]. Then there exist an affine scheme $S_1$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], an etale morphism $a:S_1\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $s_1\in S_1$ with $a(s_1)=s$ and $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(s_1)$ an isomorphism, together with a quasi-compact open subscheme $V\subseteq Y\times_S S_1$, such that every fibre of $V\to S_1$ is geometrically connected and $V_{s_1}=T\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)}\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s_1)$ as open subschemes of $(Y\times_S S_1)_{s_1}$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-fibre-open-affine-reduction] to obtain an affine open S₀ containing s and a quasi-compact open W in Y ×_S S₀ with the prescribed embedded special fibre T. Write g:W→S₀ and j:W→Y. The fibre map for the open immersion j has image (h.fiberι s)⁻¹(j.opensRange)=T and is an open immersion; identify it with T by the isomorphism of open immersions with equal range. Its structure map is therefore geometrically connected. The square with horizontal map id_W and bottom open immersion S₀→S is cartesian, so base change along its residue-field map gives geometric connectedness of g at s₀=(s,hs).

The geometrically connected fibre g_s₀ is nonempty. Apply [lem-trf-affine-etale-finite-free-multisection] to g. This supplies an affine elementary étale neighbourhood a:U→S₀ with a(u₀)=s₀, a finite locally free p:E→U with nonempty singleton fibre, and σ:E→W_U over U. Register the flat, locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated base-changed family supplied by this declaration. Its geometric reducedness and the geometric connectedness of its u₀-fibre are also supplied there.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-finite-locally-free-multisection-connected-open] to the base-changed family, p and σ. A point of the nonempty fibre of p explicitly witnesses that the range of its fibre inclusion is nonempty. Obtain a compact open immersion i:X0→W_U inducing an isomorphism on the u₀-fibre, with every nonempty fibre geometrically connected.

Apply [lem-trf-connected-open-etale-refinement] to h,g,j,S₀→S, the equality specifying T, the elementary étale neighbourhood a, and the open immersion i. The original g and its base changes are flat and locally of finite presentation. The original geometrically connected u₀-fibre is nonempty. The refinement theorem shrinks U to an affine neighbourhood in the open image of X0→U, preserves compactness, composes the elementary étale base maps, and proves the displayed equality of opens using the canonical fibre map. Its result is exactly the claimed neighbourhood and V.

lean.statement: theorem exists_geometricallyConnected_fibre_neighbourhood {Y S : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ S) [Flat h] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation h] [QuasiCompact h] [QuasiSeparated h] [GeometricallyReduced h] (s : S) (T : (h.fiber s).Opens) [GeometricallyConnected (T.ι ≫ h.fiberToSpecResidueField s)] : ∃ (S₁ : Scheme.{u}) (a : S₁ ⟶ S) (s₁ : S₁) (hs : a s₁ = s), IsAffine S₁ ∧ Etale a ∧ IsIso (a.residueFieldMap s₁) ∧ ∃ V : (pullback h a).Opens, IsCompact (V : Set ↥(pullback h a)) ∧ GeometricallyConnected (V.ι ≫ pullback.snd h a) ∧ (pullback.snd h a).fiberι s₁ ⁻¹ᵁ V = (pullback.map (pullback.snd h a) (S₁.fromSpecResidueField s₁) h (S.fromSpecResidueField (a s₁)) (pullback.fst h a) (Spec.map (a.residueFieldMap s₁)) a (pullback.condition (f := h) (g := a)).symm (a.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField s₁).symm ≫ eqToHom (congrArg h.fiber hs)) ⁻¹ᵁ T
